input: How did Boeing's total revenues change from fiscal year 2024 to 2025, and what does management attribute the change to?
final_output: Boeing's total revenues increased from $66,517 million in 2024 to $89,463 million in 2025. Management attributes this improvement primarily to higher deliveries on commercial airplane programs during 2025 compared to 2024. The context explains that inventories decreased favorably by $10.9 billion driven by 'higher deliveries on our commercial airplane programs during 2025 as compared to 2024,' and accounts payable increased reflecting 'increased production primarily in our commercial airplanes business.'
